title: Live Crypto Trading on CoinSwitch — Step by Step for Beginners
description:
Most beginners lose money on their first trade not because of bad analysis — but because they don't understand how the platform works, what leverage actually does, and why their position got liquidated without warning.

In this video, Ahmed Ali Khan does a complete live walkthrough of trading on the CoinSwitch app — from understanding Spot vs Futures to placing real buy and sell orders, setting take profit, stop loss, and understanding liquidation price. Every step shown live on screen.

What you'll learn:
- The key difference between Spot and Futures trading in crypto
- How leverage works and why high leverage is dangerous for beginners
- How to place Market Orders vs Limit Orders and when to use each
- How to set Take Profit and Stop Loss on an open position
- What liquidation price means and how to stay safe from it
- How to read the Order Book to find better entry and exit levels

This video is for you if: You've set up your CoinSwitch account and added funds but have no idea how to actually place a trade without risking your money unnecessarily.

Trade smarter with CoinSwitch.

0:00 - Precap: Leverage & Liquidation Warning
0:21 - Introduction & What This Video Covers
0:58 - CoinSwitch App Interface Walkthrough
2:34 - Spot vs Futures: Key Differences Explained
6:14 - How Leverage Works (5x to 400x explained)
7:38 - Navigating Futures & Options on Pro Dashboard
9:50 - Buy/Long & Sell/Short Order Panel Explained
10:20 - Market Order vs Limit Order Explaine
13:10 - Placing a Live Limit Buy Order on BTC
16:47 - Setting Take Profit & Stop Loss on Live Trade
19:26 - Liquidation Price Explained
21:10 - Placing a Live Sell (Short) Order on ETH
24:45 - How to Read the Order Book
20:02 - End & Key Takeaways

⚠️ Crypto products and NFTs are unregulated and can be highly risky. There may be no regulatory recourse for any loss from such transactions.
